test_title: PYST 24 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 21 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Choose the correct passive voice transformation of the sentence:**

The government is to launch an extensive investigation into the alleged financial irregularities.

options.text: An extensive investigation is to be launched into the alleged financial irregularities by the government.
The alleged financial irregularities are to be extensively investigated by the government.
An extensive investigation will be launched into the alleged financial irregularities by the government.
It is intended by the government to launch an extensive investigation into the alleged financial irregularities.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The government is to launch an extensive investigation into the alleged financial irregularities."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "an extensive investigation" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "is to launch" to "is to be launched" (future passive structure).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the government."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"An extensive investigation is to be launched into the alleged financial irregularities by the government."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"The alleged financial irregularities are to be extensively investigated by the government." – Incorrect structure as it changes the focus of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3: **"An extensive investigation will be launched into the alleged financial irregularities by the government." – Incorrect tense (future simple instead of "is to be").
 
• **Option 4: **"It is intended by the government to launch an extensive investigation into the alleged financial irregularities." – Incorrect transformation, as it alters the original meaning.
